summary: The preschool app with Montessori learning games from our hit shows!
description: Car City World is the ultimate app for little kids aged 2 to 5 who like to play with toy cars! Enjoy the very best of Car City games and educational activities in one single fun app! Car City World is designed to address preschoolers specific intellectual and emotional needs. Car City is safe, intuitive and full of fun surprises! Features - Play fun games with new games regularly added - Watch Car City TV with new shows each week - Learn through many educational activities - Grow inspired by our heroes and their positive values - Download and access everything offline - Enjoy regular new videos and games What is in this app? CAR CITY TV Watch new Car City shows each week. Our hit show Carl the Super Truck of Car City is followed by over 2 million families. Now you can enjoy it in a safe environment without ads! CARL THE SUPER TRUCK ROADWORKS Dig, drill and build with Carl to help Car City residents in this adventure game CARL THE SUPER SUBMARINE: OCEAN EXPLORATION SCHOOL Splash! Dive underwater and discover the wonders of the world’s oceans! Find out what shapes, colors and numbers lie at the bottom of the sea! TOM’S ART GALLERY Get in touch with your artistic side with this creative game to draw and be creative alongside your favorite Car city characters! & many other apps and games! Subscription details The limited version is available for free and can be played indefinitely to try our games and discover our universe! Car City World has a subscription service with cartoons and games for toddlers and preschoolers aged 2 to 5. Should you become a fan, you can enjoy complete and unlimited access to all the content we create for a small monthly or yearly fee. In addition, get exclusive content and features as well as early access to our new games. A free trial is also offered to try the full version. Please make sure you cancel your subscription before the free trial expires so that you won’t be charged. If subscriptions aren’t for you, you can also opt to pay once for life time access.
